name: 1911 Data Centres Walbrzych modular data center campus
notes: Planned modular data center campus in Walbrzych south of Wroclaw; DCD reports PLN 2bn investment, 46MW IT load, construction scheduled for H2 2025.

name: T-Mobile Wroclaw Data Center
notes: T-Mobile official page states it has commercial data centres in Cracow, Warsaw and Wroclaw; third-party listing places the Wroclaw facility in Lower Silesia and says it was established in 2010.

name: Korbank Wroclaw data center
notes: Cloudscene identifies Wroclaw as a market with 9 colocation data centers and lists Korbank as the leading Wroclaw provider; Data Center Map lists Wroclaw facilities.

name: Dataspace Torun
notes: Dataspace official contact page gives the Torun address; Data Center Map reports a 2MW facility at Wloclawska 161, while Inflect describes colocation and technical space.

name: Exea Data Center Torun
notes: Exea official site identifies Exea Data Center at ul. Wloclawska 167, Torun; Data Center Map reports 6MW; local Torun Direct article says Exea Data Center has operated in Torun since 2015.

name: Asseco Bydgoszcz Data Center
notes: DCD reports Asseco operated three data centers in Poland including Bydgoszcz; Data Center Map lists Asseco Bydgoszcz at Karola Kurpinskiego 9 with Tier 3.

name: Orange Bydgoszcz
notes: Third-party data center directories list Orange Bydgoszcz / Orange Polska Bydgoszcz at Chodkiewicza 61 and identify it as a data center/interconnection facility.

name: Orange Polska Lublin Data Center
notes: Inflect and DataCenterPlatform list Orange Lublin at ul. Chodzki 8/10; DCHub reports operational status and 3.0MW capacity.

name: CenterServ Lublin Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists CenterServ Lublin Data Center in Lublin; CenterServ official materials describe its managed datacenter network, but the Lublin-specific evidence is directory-sourced.

name: Hyperscale Data Center Belchatow / Domiechowice campus
developer: Undisclosed investor; Belchatow Commune industrial zone
notes: DCD and Warsaw Business Journal report a planned 500MW hyperscale campus on more than 50 ha in Domiechowice, Belchatow Commune; talks with investor reported advanced.

name: Orange Polska CPD Lodz
notes: Telecompaper reported Orange Poland extending its CPD in Lodz with another 900 sqm server room; current directories list CPD Lodz at Stokowska 15/17.

name: Asseco Lodz Data Center
notes: DCD reports Asseco operated data centers in Lodz, Szczecin and Bydgoszcz; Data Center Map lists Asseco Lodz at Narutowicza 136 and provides M&A history from CK ZETO to Asseco.

name: Kylos Lodz Data Center
notes: Data Center Map's Lodz market listing includes Kylos Data Center at Gen. Walerego Wroblewskiego 18; Baxtel also lists it as a nearby Lodz facility.

name: Polcom Data Center Skawina
notes: Polcom official page says Skawina near Cracow was put into service in 2011, has 6,000 sqm area and 15MW power.

name: Polcom DC3 Skawina
notes: DCD reports Polcom is building two data centers near Krakow with combined 44MW; directory detail attributes 22MW to DC3 in Skawina and indicates expected operation by end-2026.

name: Polcom DC4 Skawina
notes: Second of Polcom's two planned Skawina-area facilities; DCD reports the pair at 44MW combined and PLN 100m investment including a 1.7MW PV farm.

name: Comarch Krakow Data Center
notes: Comarch official page says its Krakow data center is next to its headquarters and was established in 2015 to support expansion.

name: Netia Data Center SOUL Krakow
notes: Netia official page identifies Data Center SOUL, formerly Onet Data Center, in Krakow; Cloudscene states it spans 3,200 sqm with about 500 racks.

name: T-Mobile Krakow Data Center
notes: T-Mobile official page states it operates commercial centres in Cracow, Warsaw and Wroclaw; DCD notes the Krakow facility was built in 2005 and expanded in 2018 with 400 sqm colocation space.

name: Microsoft Poland Central cloud region
notes: Microsoft official announcement says the Polish cloud region opened around Warsaw and consists of three independent physical locations, each with one or more datacenters.

name: Google Cloud Warsaw region europe-central2
notes: Google Cloud official blog announced opening of the Warsaw region; current Google documentation lists Warsaw, Poland as europe-central2.

name: DATA4 Warsaw-Jawczyce campus
notes: DATA4 official campus page lists Warsaw-Jawczyce at Przyparkowa 21 with available IT power up to 60MW; DCD reported launch in May 2023.

name: Atman Data Center Warsaw-3
notes: Atman official page gives WAW-3 target IT capacity of 43MW across three buildings; DCD reports first phase launched with 14.4MW and full build-out 43MW.

name: Vantage Warsaw WAW1 campus
notes: Vantage official materials describe Warsaw WAW1 on more than 12 acres near Warsaw-Chopin Airport; when fully developed the two-building campus provides 48MW critical IT capacity.

name: Equinix Warsaw IBX and WA4x data centers
notes: Equinix official Warsaw page describes its Warsaw data centers as a major interconnection gateway and mentions WA1, WA2, WA3 and WA4x, with WA4x its first xScale hyperscale data center in Warsaw.

name: EdgeConneX Warsaw data centers
notes: EdgeConneX official Warsaw page lists the Warsaw, Poland data center location; Inflect reports the Modularna 17 Warsaw facility with 6MW total power.

name: Orange Warsaw Data Hub
notes: Orange official page gives the Warsaw Data Hub address at Aleja Krakowska 180, Lazy near Warsaw; DCD reported opening in 2021 with four 400 sqm data halls.

name: Netia Data Center MIND Jawczyce
notes: Netia official page says Data Center in Jawczyce was commissioned on April 1, 2021 with 1,060 sqm server space and nearly 700 sqm office space; DCD reported opening near Warsaw.

name: Greykite / White Star Warsaw 65MW redevelopment
developer: Greykite and White Star; reportedly leased to EdgeConneX
notes: DCD reports Greykite is converting a former Warsaw logistics site into a 65MW data center with White Star and reported EdgeConneX lease involvement.

name: PNT Data Center Opole
developer: Science and Technology Park in Opole / PNT Data Center
notes: PNT official pages identify the Data Center at Technologiczna 2, Opole and describe it as Rated 3 certified; Data Center Map reports the facility was established in 2019 and covers about 500 sqm.

name: Orange Polska Rzeszow Data Center
notes: Inflect lists Orange Business Services Rzeszow at ul. Pilsudskiego 35 as a data center; no primary Orange page for this specific regional facility was found.

name: Citynet Rzeszow Data Center
notes: Inflect identifies Citynet Rzeszow as a Rzeszow data center; ColoMap describes Rzeszow as having one verified colocation data center and active network presence.

name: Orange Polska Bialystok Data Center
notes: Inflect lists Orange Polska Bialystok at 10 Koscielna and reports 1.5MW total power with N+1 redundancy; DataCenterPlatform also lists Orange Bialystok at the same address.
